title: Fix final SRD spell-section boundary contamination
description:
﻿Fix D&D SRD 5.1 spell parser boundary contamination found during the final pack accuracy audit.

Problem:
The committed canonical pack contains spell records whose descriptions include text from adjacent or non-spell sections:
- spell:word-of-recall has stray text contamination around the ending, including text associated with Wish / neighboring spell content.
- spell:zone-of-truth absorbs the following Traps section after the spell should end.

This means the spell parser can have correct spell counts while still corrupting the final spell bodies.

Scope:
- Fix spell-section slicing / spell body termination for the end of the Spell Descriptions section.
- Ensure the final spell, Zone of Truth, ends at the true spell text boundary and does not include Traps content.
- Ensure Word of Recall body text matches the vendored SRD 5.1 PDF and is not contaminated by neighboring spell content.
- Regenerate the canonical D&D SRD 5.1 pack after parser fixes.
- Keep verify:dnd5e-srd-pack strict and green.

Acceptance criteria:
- spell:word-of-recall description is supported by the vendored SRD 5.1 PDF and contains no neighboring-spell contamination.
- spell:zone-of-truth description ends at the spell text and does not contain Traps section content.
- Add targeted regression tests for both Word of Recall and Zone of Truth.
- npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exits 0.
- npm run audit:rules-pack -- packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1 reports no new suspicious findings.
- npm run check, npm run typecheck, and npm test pass.
- Do not change source vendoring policy.
- Do not add exact creature name work; that is already covered by the reviewed creature baseline.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #143: added Traps to spellDescriptions end anchor (Zone of Truth boundary) and added gutter-straggler reassignment in extract.ts (Word of Recall 'wish' contamination). Pack regenerated; verify/audit/check/typecheck/test all green; regression tests added.
